{{recipe}}

This is an old family recipe for '''chicken on salt''' from [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Russia|Russia]].

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], plucked and dressed
* 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]], quartered
* 4 peeled cloves of [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* Several sprigs of fresh [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==
#Stuff the chicken with the quartered lemon, garlic and rosemary.
#Bind the chicken ready for roasting.
#Fill a baking tray with the salt and place the chicken on top.
#[[Cookbook:Roasting|Roast]] for 90 minutes at 190°[[Cookbook:Celsius|C]]. The flesh should be moist and the skin crisp.
